name: comp-309
title: Feature Launch Banner
description: A full-width dark banner with a bold headline over a muted one-line description, a white Try now button and a close X that removes it.
use: You want a short launch message with a headline, supporting line and one action button.
avoid: Two lines of fixed copy with no persistence, so the strip returns on every reload.
a11y: Close is labelled and the rocket badge is hidden from screen readers, but the file adds no focus styling or reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-width dark strip holds a bold white headline above a smaller grey line on the left. At the right sit a white rounded Try now button and a faint X; a circular rocket badge is cut off at the left edge.
behaves: Pressing the X hides the strip, and the X brightens on hover. Try now has no action wired, so the clip only shows the resting banner.
customise: Headline, description and button label are fixed in the file; visibility is a local flag with no props.
weight: light: Two short lines, one button and a single state flag.
